comments.author: Nem Schlecht
comments.html:
Hey Adam.
I'm the one who said "scripting language", Travis had the XML-RPC comment. Like I said in the podcast, I just started looking at Dtrace, and I was immediately impressed (I hope I at least got that across in the podcast).
Being a UNIX guy, I consider remarking that something is like a scripting language to be a compliment. ;-)
If you're interested, we'd love to you have on the show to talk more about Dtrace (and set me straight!)
-- Nem
